Sometime between [[3973 BBY]] and [[3965 BBY]], during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the conflict known as the [[Mandalorian Wars]],<ref name="Date" /> a '''battle''' was fought in the [[Sy Myrth system/Legends|Sy Myrth system]] between the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The battle in the [[Sy Myrth/Legends|Sy Myrth]] [[Star system/Legends|star system]] ended in a Mandalorian victory, and it was preceded by a like [[Battle of the Jaminere system|outcome]] in the [[Jaminere system/Legends|Jaminere system]]. The Neo-Crusaders then went on to [[Battle of the Taskeed system|raid]] the [[Taskeed system/Legends|Taskeed system]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle in the Sy Myrth system was referenced in [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA" />
